northStar: Build a Commander-specialist system that consistently outperforms strong general-purpose AI at Commander deck construction and analysis by combining expert human-level strategic understanding with machine-level verification, search, exact math, simulation, and counterfactual testing—and prove that advantage on adversarial benchmarks.

experimental.developmentCheckpointNote: Exact checked-in INTEL-02 source for the first materially different unrestricted precon generalization pass. Build and name-agnostic strategy regressions passed, including weak incidental attack handling, self-mill recovery, artifact-engine semantics, mass-graveyard-return semantics, artifact-specific unrestricted discovery and artifact-engine win-route reporting. The exact MTGJSON Necron Dynasties stock control also passed hard legality/budget truth, target-quality and strategy-preservation gates at this source. Independent before/after evaluation moved the deck from Bracket 2 to Bracket 3, average nonland mana value 3.79 -> 3.29, early plays 15 -> 18, cheap interaction 1 -> 5, tutors 0 -> 4, interaction 7 -> 13 and protection 1 -> 5 while graveyard affinity increased 237 -> 249 and artifact affinity increased 333 -> 339. The requested Bracket 4 was not achieved, so this is a whole-deck improvement/generalization pass, not target certification. Earlier Necron runs that misclassified Szarekh as combat-tokens and hollowed the artifact/graveyard engine are regression evidence, not successful intelligence evidence. Later evidence/state-only commits do not replace this tested source SHA.

latestPersistedMarvelControl.note: Exact-source focused and broad restricted Marvel controls passed at this checkpoint. Two swaps—Vanquish the Horde -> Vandalblast and Arcane Signet -> Ponder—moved average nonland mana value 2.71 -> 2.59, repaired that failed construction gate, added no failed construction gate, preserved exact 100 Marvel-family printings, retained Lightning Greaves and all eight tutors, and carried complete passing strategy/cut evidence. The final deck remained Bracket 4 with zero verified winning combos, so this is restricted INTEL-02 evidence rather than INTEL-01 validation.

latestPersistedFoodPreconControl.note: Exact Food and Fellowship stock-precon control made four supported swaps while retaining Food/lifegain affinity, recursion, board wipes and persistent colored mana. This supplied the materially different restricted/precon-style whole-deck improvement evidence required before broadening conditions.

latestPersistedUnrestrictedPreconControl.note: Exact MTGJSON stock baseline, unrestricted Commander-legal physical upgrades under NZ$35/card and NZ$200 total. The final legal exact-100 list used 12 swaps for NZ$134.61, assessed Bracket 2 -> 3, improved MV 3.79 -> 3.29, early plays 15 -> 18, cheap interaction 1 -> 5, tutors 0 -> 4, interaction 7 -> 13, protection 1 -> 5, and increased both graveyard and artifact aggregate affinity. It remained one bracket below the requested Bracket 4 and is therefore recorded as a high-quality whole-deck improvement/generalization pass, not target achievement.

requiredBeforeResumingIntelligenceClaims: Repeat unrestricted or materially different-condition whole-deck improvement on additional archetypes beyond the current Necron artifact/graveyard engine before closing INTEL-02
Keep explicit cut-impact, structural-card importance and per-strategy preservation evidence active so generic role gains cannot hollow out secondary or engine identities
Verified full-table win-route discovery, injection and final evaluation agree in a scenario where an eligible route exists
Negative win-package conclusions distinguish completed bounded absence from provider unavailability or selection failure
Commander legality, exact 100 cards, printing-family/set restrictions and budgets remain intact across the expanded controls

truthBoundary: Commander legality, exact card count, singleton and color identity outrank optimization scores.
Exact physical-printing existence/restrictions and hard budgets are fail-closed truths.
Provider unavailable is not evidence of absence.
A generic infinite-damage statement is not a verified multiplayer full-table win unless opponent scope is proven.
Pipeline execution is not proof of intelligent deck improvement.
No merge, stable/current promotion, version bump, or release without explicit user approval.
nextActions: Run the next materially different unrestricted/precon INTEL-02 challenge on an archetype that is not artifact/graveyard recursion, and require independent before/after whole-deck improvement plus generic commander-strategy preservation rather than a forced target hit.

Use the Necron false-green history as a regression boundary: incidental command-zone text must not define the deck identity, and every substantive commander strategy must survive the complete accepted package, not merely individual score gains.

After at least one more materially different unrestricted archetype succeeds, vary budget and card-pool pressure to test whether the refiner can make smaller coherent upgrades or truthfully stop when no supported improvement exists.

Run an eligible verified full-table package scenario to validate INTEL-01 discovery, feasibility, atomic injection, protection and independent final recognition end to end; current Marvel, Middle-earth, Food and Necron controls do not provide that positive win-route proof.
Migrate legacy KF-013 evidence writers to isolated paths plus bounded latest-head reconciliation before treating concurrent persistence as globally closed.

handoffProtocol.then: Inspect the live active-branch head and PR state. Use the validation index to decide which persisted controls are current or stale, then continue only from the active milestone and nextActions.
